answer.diagnosis: visit_ListComp binds each item and unconditionally appends its element, completely ignoring comp.ifs. Actual device observations show 5/5 mismatches for constexpr-filter-00 and 7/7 for constexpr-filter-02; the passing control constexpr-filter-01 has 0/5 mismatches when filtering should retain every entry. Evaluate predicates in source order after binding each item, stop at the first false predicate, and evaluate/append the element only when all predicates pass. This preserves input order and implements short-circuit AND, including retaining every entry when there are no predicates. Use existing constexpr unwrapping and condition-type validation; runtime tensor predicates cannot determine a compile-time tuple length and are rejected. Compilation and post-patch device results are unavailable, so the repair has not been execution-verified.
